title: The Onward Brass Band cap
summary: A photo shows Picou in a brass band cap, which he says came from the Onward band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Where did you get the hat from, Pete?
Well, yeah, you all had it working.
All of us had to have a cap like that.
What band was that you were playing with down there?
Oh, yeah. The onward band. Onward cap, huh? Did you have the name written on it or anything like that or just a plain cap?
